info.title: FoodOnTheGo API
info.description: Contract for /api/v1. Conventions: snake_case JSON; single resources are returned unwrapped; collections are {data, links, meta}; every error is {error: {code, message, details?, request_id}}; money is {amount, currency} with amount in integer minor units and an ISO 4217 currency; identifiers are public UUIDs (internal numeric ids are never exposed); timestamps are ISO 8601 in UTC; countries are ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; time zones are IANA ids. Every response carries X-Request-Id. Authentication: three separate bearer-token contexts (customer, restaurant, admin); a token is accepted only by routes of its own context, the account state is re-checked on every request, and sensitive endpoints are rate limited (429 rate_limited with Retry-After). tests/Feature/Foundation/OpenApiContractTest.php fails when the routes or the documented response shapes drift from this file.

post.summary: Send a one-time code. Channels are tried cheapest first (e.g. WhatsApp, then SMS): the first code uses the first channel, each resend the next; `channel` asks for a specific one. Same answer for new and existing customers; never returns the code. Limits: per phone and per address per minute, resend cooldown, hourly cap per phone
Verify the code and sign in. Creates the customer on first use (201). Errors: otp_invalid (details.attempts_left), otp_expired, otp_attempts_exceeded (429), account_not_active (403)

201.description: New customer created and signed in

patch.summary: Update the signed-in customer's own name, e-mail, locale; accept the terms

post.summary: Restaurant user sign-in with e-mail and password. With MFA enabled the answer is a challenge, not a token. Errors: invalid_credentials (401, generic), account_not_active (403)
Restaurant user: complete sign-in with a TOTP code or a recovery code. Errors: mfa_challenge_invalid (401), mfa_code_invalid (422), mfa_attempts_exceeded (429)
Restaurant user: request a password reset link. The answer is identical whether or not the account exists
Restaurant user: set a new password with a reset token (expiring, single use). All sessions are signed out. Error: reset_token_invalid
Admin user sign-in with e-mail and password. With MFA enabled the answer is a challenge, not a token. Errors: invalid_credentials (401, generic), account_not_active (403)
Admin user: complete sign-in with a TOTP code or a recovery code. Errors: mfa_challenge_invalid (401), mfa_code_invalid (422), mfa_attempts_exceeded (429)
Admin user: request a password reset link. The answer is identical whether or not the account exists
Admin user: set a new password with a reset token (expiring, single use). All sessions are signed out. Error: reset_token_invalid

customer.description: Opaque access token of a customer. Stored hashed, expiring, revocable. Not accepted by routes of another context.

restaurant.description: Opaque access token of a restaurant user. Stored hashed, expiring, revocable. Not accepted by routes of another context.

admin.description: Opaque access token of a admin user. Stored hashed, expiring, revocable. Not accepted by routes of another context.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code, e.g. validation_failed, unauthenticated, forbidden, not_found, conflict, rate_limited, internal_error, or a domain code such as market_unavailable

debug.description: Only when APP_DEBUG is on (never in production)

phone_country_code.description: UX default for phone inputs, not a validation rule

phone.description: Any common format; normalised to E.164 by the server in the market's context

country.description: Market of the number; defaults to the default market

channel.description: Optional: ask for this channel instead of the automatic order

resend_available_at.description: Server decides; the client countdown is decoration

delivery.description: live = a real message was sent on `channel`; development = local / testing, nothing was sent. The code itself is never returned

resend_channel.description: Channel a resend would start with

version.description: Optional optimistic concurrency: when sent, a stale value is refused with 409 stale_update

favorite_cuisines.description: Cuisine codes of the taxonomy, at most 10

mfa_enrollment_required.description: true = this token can only enrol in MFA

CoverageStatus.description: Service areas and route corridors. Only ACTIVE serves customers; TESTING is internal.

GeoJsonGeometry.description: GeoJSON geometry (RFC 7946): WGS84, positions are [longitude, latitude]. No "crs" member is accepted.

country_code.description: Hint from the places provider; a value that contradicts the market means "not this market"

route_corridors.description: Operational corridors whose band contains the point (supported locations only)

RestaurantProfileUpdate.description: Plain text only: markup is refused with 422. Status, slug, organization, market, coordinates, address, time zone and currency cannot be sent here (422).

paused_until.description: ISO 8601; must be in the future; orders resume by themselves when it passes

RestaurantAvailabilityUpdate.description: At least one of accepting_orders, operational_status. A switch: the last request wins. Pausing never changes orders that were already accepted.

date.description: Local calendar date of the location

version.description: The hours version the caller edited

opens_at.description: Wall-clock HH:MM in the time zone of the location

closes_at.description: Wall-clock HH:MM in the time zone of the location

RestaurantHoursReplace.description: The whole week; replaces every stored period in one transaction. An empty list = closed all week. Periods must not overlap, also across midnight.

date.description: Local calendar date of the location
Local calendar date of the location

SpecialHourCreate.description: One exception per date. A closed date has no periods; an open one needs at least one.

date.description: Local calendar date of the location

capacity_per_slot.description: Reserved for pickup-slot capacity; null = not limited

limits.description: Platform bounds per setting: [min, max], or the list of allowed slot intervals

PickupSettings.description: Settings only. Pickup slots, slot capacity checks and the dynamic preparation estimate are a later module.

version.description: The version the caller edited (optimistic concurrency); a stale value is refused with 409 stale_update

PickupSettingsUpdate.description: A mode or method the market has not enabled is refused with 409 (pickup_mode_not_available / pickup_method_not_available).

RestaurantMember.description: A staff membership. Never a password, MFA detail or invitation token.

location_ids.description: Locations of this organization; required when all_locations is false

version.description: The version the caller edited (optimistic concurrency); a stale value is refused with 409 stale_update

password.description: Required when the invited person has no account yet

allowed_transitions.description: Status changes THIS administrator may make from here

counts.description: Locations per status in the scope of the caller

status_note.description: Explanation of a rejection or suspension that the restaurant may read

version.description: Version of the weekly schedule (separate from the profile version)

date.description: Local calendar date of the location

allowed_transitions.description: Status changes THIS administrator may make from here

service_area.description: The stored association (covering area with the highest priority). Availability is decided from the geometry.

allowed_transitions.description: Status changes THIS administrator may make from here

notes.description: Internal — never part of a restaurant or customer response

AdminRestaurant.description: A location as administrators see it, with what only the platform decides or knows

Status changes THIS administrator may make from here

has_owner.description: An active member can manage the staff for all locations

version.description: The version the caller edited (optimistic concurrency); a stale value is refused with 409 stale_update

reason.description: Internal reason (audit trail). Required for REJECTED, SUSPENDED and INACTIVE.

public_reason.description: Explanation the restaurant may read. Required for REJECTED.

RestaurantStatusChange.description: Only the transitions of the lifecycle are accepted (409 invalid_status_transition otherwise).

version.description: The version the caller edited (optimistic concurrency); a stale value is refused with 409 stale_update

market_id.description: Defaults to the organization's primary market

city_id.description: Optional; must agree with the coordinates

timezone.description: IANA id; defaults to the city's

currency.description: ISO 4217; must be one the market supports; defaults to the market's

AdminRestaurantLocationCreate.description: Created as DRAFT. Region, city and service area are resolved from the coordinates by PostGIS; nothing geographic is taken from the request.

version.description: The version the caller edited (optimistic concurrency); a stale value is refused with 409 stale_update

city_id.description: Optional; must agree with the coordinates

timezone.description: IANA id; defaults to the city's

currency.description: ISO 4217; must be one the market supports; defaults to the market's

AdminRestaurantUpdate.description: latitude and longitude are sent together; a move resolves the geography again.

role.description: A restaurant role code; default OWNER

RestaurantPickupOffer.description: What a customer can actually use: the settings of the location limited by what its market allows

MenuStatus.description: Only an ACTIVE menu is shown to customers. A restaurant switches between ACTIVE and INACTIVE; DRAFT is the unpublished start.

MenuCategoryStatus.description: INACTIVE hides the category and its items from customers; ARCHIVED is final.

MenuItemStatus.description: SOLD_OUT and TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE stay visible to customers but cannot be ordered; DISABLED and ARCHIVED are hidden. ARCHIVED is final (orders keep their history).

MenuOptionGroupKind.description: VARIANT: a size or portion that defines the item (usually required, single choice). MODIFIER: an addition, a level or an instruction. Both follow the same required / min / max rules.

MenuOptionStatus.description: TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE is shown to customers as not selectable; DISABLED and ARCHIVED are hidden.

MenuAvailabilityReason.description: Why an item cannot be ordered right now, in the order the backend checks: restaurant → menu → category → item → required groups. OUTSIDE_ITEM_SCHEDULE is reserved.

DietaryTagKind.description: DIET: how it is prepared (vegetarian, vegan, Jain). CONTAINS: what it contains (egg, nuts, dairy). PREFERENCE: free of something (gluten-free, halal).

DietaryTagRef.description: A label chosen by the restaurant from the platform list. Informational — never a safety guarantee; allergen_information is free text for that.

orderable.description: A customer may add the item right now. reason is null exactly when this is true.

restaurant_reason.description: When reason is RESTAURANT_UNAVAILABLE: why the restaurant itself cannot be ordered from (customer reasons on customer routes, exact reasons for staff)

MenuItemAvailability.description: Calculated by the backend for this request. Clients display it and never decide it themselves.

url.description: Absolute URL served by GET /media/{path}; immutable, may be cached for a day. No storage path appears anywhere.

quantity_per_line.description: [min, max] a customer may order of one configuration

instructions.description: Maximum length of a customer note on an item (used by the cart later)

MenuLimits.description: Platform limits the dashboard builds its forms from. Not market facts: the currency of a menu is the currency of its location.

price_adjustment_minor.description: Added to the base price. Negative = a reduction, never larger than the base price.

options.description: Every option that is not archived, in display order

slug.description: The address of the item under its restaurant; created once from the name, kept when the item is renamed, changed only by an explicit slug field

base_price_minor.description: Integer minor units of the menu currency (paise for INR). Never a decimal.

currency.description: ISO 4217, always the currency of the menu

orderable.description: A customer may add the item right now. reason is null exactly when this is true.

restaurant_reason.description: When reason is RESTAURANT_UNAVAILABLE: why the restaurant itself cannot be ordered from (customer reasons on customer routes, exact reasons for staff)

currency.description: ISO 4217 — the currency of the location. Never sent by a client.

catalog_version.description: Increases on every customer-visible change: the cache key of the customer menu and the token clients carry to notice a changed menu

items.description: Every item of the menu in display order within its category

ManagedMenu.description: The management document of one location: everything that is not archived (?include=archived adds archived categories and items), with the versions edits must send back

currency.description: ISO 4217 — the currency of the location. Never sent by a client.

items.description: Every item of the menu in display order within its category

MenuUpdate.description: The currency cannot be changed: it is the currency of the location.

MenuCategoryCreate.description: Appended at the end of the menu

version.description: The version the caller edited (optimistic concurrency); a stale value is refused with 409 stale_update

categories.description: Every category of the menu that is not archived, exactly once, in the new order

items.description: Every item of the category that is not archived, exactly once, in the new order

id.description: Keep an existing option (its id stays stable for carts); omit for a new one

price_adjustment_minor.description: Minor units; negative only when the platform allows it and never below the base price of the item

id.description: Keep an existing group; omit for a new one

MenuOptionGroupInput.description: Rules enforced together: max ≥ 1, min ≤ max, required ⇒ min ≥ 1 and at least one available option, max ≤ number of options. Groups and options that are missing from the document are archived, never deleted.

base_price_minor.description: Minor units of the menu currency

max_quantity.description: Most a customer may order of one configuration; min is always 1

dietary_tags.description: Tag codes from GET /restaurant/taxonomy, at most dietary_tags_per_item

groups.description: The whole option configuration of the item, in display order

MenuItemCreate.description: Item, dietary tags, groups and options in one transaction. currency, menu_id, location_id, slug and archived_at are refused: the menu decides them.

version.description: The version the caller edited (optimistic concurrency); a stale value is refused with 409 stale_update

slug.description: Only to change the address deliberately; must be free within the menu

base_price_minor.description: Minor units of the menu currency

max_quantity.description: Most a customer may order of one configuration; min is always 1

dietary_tags.description: Tag codes from GET /restaurant/taxonomy, at most dietary_tags_per_item

groups.description: The whole option configuration of the item, in display order

MenuItemUpdate.description: Any field; groups replaces the configuration (see MenuOptionGroupInput). A price change and a status change are audited separately.

MenuItemStatusChange.description: A switch without a version: the last request wins. Archiving is DELETE /restaurant/menu/items/{item}.

MenuBulkStatusChange.description: Every listed item must belong to this menu and not be archived — all of them change or none.

image.description: JPEG, PNG or WebP, 200 – 4000 px each side, at most image_max_bytes. Checked by content, never by file name.

price_adjustment_minor.description: Integer minor units of the menu currency (paise for INR). Never a decimal.

available.description: False while temporarily unavailable: shown, not selectable. Disabled and archived options are not listed at all.

PublicMenuOptionGroup.description: The rules a client validates against before asking for a price quote; the backend enforces the same rules again.

base_price_minor.description: Integer minor units of the menu currency (paise for INR). Never a decimal.

customizable.description: The item has at least one group with a visible option

PublicMenuItem.description: An item in the menu list: price and state, no option details (see the item route)

catalog_version.description: Changes whenever the menu changes; clients compare it later to notice a stale menu

categories.description: ACTIVE categories in display order, each with its visible items

dietary_tags.description: The labels used on this menu, for filters

PublicMenu.description: The published menu of a restaurant customers may see. menu is null (and categories empty) when nothing is published. Prices are the configured base prices; a selection is priced by the price-quote route.

base_price_minor.description: Integer minor units of the menu currency (paise for INR). Never a decimal.

customizable.description: The item has at least one group with a visible option

selections.description: One entry per group the customer chose from; a required group must be present

quantity.description: Default 1; at most the max_quantity of the item

PriceQuoteRequest.description: unit_price_minor and price are refused (422): the backend is the only price authority.

base_price_minor.description: Integer minor units of the menu currency (paise for INR). Never a decimal.

price_adjustment_minor.description: Integer minor units of the menu currency (paise for INR). Never a decimal.

PriceQuote.description: Stateless: nothing is reserved or stored. 422 invalid_selection lists the issues in details.issues (codes: required, min_selections, max_selections, option_unavailable, unknown_group, unknown_option, duplicate_group, duplicate_option, quantity); 422 invalid_price when a configuration would fall below zero.

catalog_version.description: Changes whenever the menu changes; clients compare it later to notice a stale menu

categories.description: As customers see it (with prices), plus a MENU_INACTIVE reason on every item while the menu is unpublished

inactive_categories.description: Categories customers cannot see right now

AdminMenuOversight.description: Read-only oversight (admin.restaurants.view in the market of the location). Administrators do not edit menus.

CuisineRef.description: A cuisine of the platform taxonomy (GET /cuisines)

display_name.description: The name, or the masked phone when no name was given

phone.description: E.164 — the customer's own verified number. Read-only here: it changes only through /customer/phone-change.

phone_editable.description: Always false: the phone is the identity (Module 21) and changes only through the verified phone-change flow

email_verified.description: Always false in this module: e-mail is optional and never verified yet

locale_options.description: The locales the customer may choose from: those supported by the customer's market

market.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 of the market the account belongs to

url.description: Absolute URL served by GET /media/{path}; no storage path appears anywhere

CustomerProfile.description: The customer's own profile — only safe owner data. Never contains tokens, OTP data, internal ids or administrative notes.

image.description: JPEG, PNG or WebP, checked by content; at most 2 MiB, 120–2000 px on each side

images.description: url is a site-relative path or storage key; no file is stored by this API yet

date.description: Local calendar date of the location

hours.description: special: exceptions of the coming days; they replace the periods that would open on that date

distance_meters.description: Straight line from ?lat=&lng= — present only when coordinates were sent. Not a route distance or a detour.

PublicRestaurantOrNull.description: A restaurant location as customers see it. Only approved restaurants inside public coverage are ever returned. All text is plain text.

available.description: false when the restaurant is no longer visible to customers (suspended, under review, market paused): the favorite is kept, only the name is shown

FavoriteRestaurant.description: A favorite restaurant location of the customer, with the restaurant exactly as GET /restaurants shows it (availability included) when it is visible

added.description: true when this call created the favorite (201), false when it already existed (200)

status.description: supported: FoodOnTheGo serves this place right now; unsupported: a known place we do not serve (yet); unknown: no coordinates were saved

market.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 when the place lies in a market we know

SavedLocationCoverage.description: Decided per request from the geometry and the current market, region, city and service-area statuses — never from what was stored. A place abroad is saved and reported unsupported; saving it never activates a market.

address.description: Flexible, international; any field may be empty

SavedLocation.description: A journey origin / destination shortcut of the customer (Home, Work, …). Not a delivery address: FoodOnTheGo is pickup along a journey.

lat.description: With lng. The backend resolves market, city and service area itself; a client never sends them.

timezone.description: IANA name; derived from the market when omitted and resolvable

SavedLocationCreate.description: label plus a formatted address or coordinates. The first saved location becomes the default. customer_id, market_id, city_id, service_area_id and id are refused with 422. At most the configured limit (20) per customer.

version.description: The version the caller edited (optimistic concurrency); a stale value is refused with 409 stale_update

lat.description: With lng. The backend resolves market, city and service area itself; a client never sends them.

timezone.description: IANA name; derived from the market when omitted and resolvable

location.description: Send null to remove the coordinates (coverage becomes unknown); send lat + lng to move the point

RecentLocation.description: A place the customer explicitly chose recently. Bounded to the newest 10, deduplicated by place id or rounded coordinates, clearable at any time, pruned after 90 days. Never a movement history.

RecentLocationRecord.description: Recorded when the customer picks a place for a journey (clients wire this in Module 26). The same place again only bumps times_used.

provider.description: The payment provider that holds the real instrument ("development" for local fixtures)

status.description: EXPIRED is computed from the expiry at read time; REVOKED methods are not listed

PaymentMethodSummary.description: Safe metadata only. FoodOnTheGo never stores or returns a card number, CVV, UPI PIN, bank credential or the provider token; the provider reference stays encrypted on the server. Methods are added through the payment provider (Module 30) — there is no endpoint that accepts payment details.

locked.description: true: this channel cannot be switched off (account-security notices)

chosen.description: true when the customer set this cell explicitly; false when it follows the platform default

transactional.description: true: notices about the customer's own orders, pickups, payments and account; false: marketing, off until the customer opts in

marketing_consent.description: When any PROMOTIONS channel was first switched on / last switched off

NotificationPreferences.description: The category × channel matrix. Delivery itself is a later module; this is what the customer chose.

preferences.description: 1–48 cells; cells not sent keep their value

NotificationPreferencesUpdate.description: Switching a locked security channel off is refused with 422.

ReauthRequest.description: Sends a code to the account's own verified phone. Needed before a sensitive action when the session is older than 30 minutes.

resend_available_at.description: Server decides; the client countdown is decoration

delivery.description: live = a real message was sent on `channel`; development = local / testing, nothing was sent. The code itself is never returned

resend_channel.description: Channel a resend would start with

ReauthChallenge.description: Same shape as the sign-in challenge; the code is never returned

valid_until.description: Until when sensitive actions on this session need no new code

DeletionRequest.description: Requires recent authentication (403 reauthentication_required otherwise). Records the request and restricts the account; nothing is deleted. Erasure follows the retention and legal rules, which are PENDING FINAL BUSINESS & LEGAL APPROVAL.

phone.description: The new number, national or E.164; parsed for the customer's market unless country is given

PhoneChangeRequest.description: Requires recent authentication. The code goes to the NEW number. 409 phone_in_use when another account has it; 422 when it is the current number or invalid.

resend_available_at.description: Server decides; the client countdown is decoration

delivery.description: live = a real message was sent on `channel`; development = local / testing, nothing was sent. The code itself is never returned

resend_channel.description: Channel a resend would start with

PhoneChangeChallenge.description: Same shape as the sign-in challenge, for the new number
